title: Revenue Cycle Management Optimization
summary: Revenue Cycle Management Optimization is a focused Healthcare Services operating project that connects a specific business problem to workstreams, data, KPIs, and expected value impact.
businessProblem: Healthcare Services companies often lose margin, growth, or cash when revenue cycle management optimization is not managed with a clear owner and KPI baseline.
goal: Create a measurable improvement plan that management can execute through weekly operating cadence.
expectedImpact: Expected impact should be underwritten as run-rate EBITDA, cash release, risk reduction, or exit-story improvement after baseline validation.
